document.abstract: What an exciting year it's been so far—the energy is truly electric! This year's NAB Show was my first since 2017, and it felt very different in all the best ways. It was invigorating to be back in the thick of it, especially alongside SMPTE New England Fellows Paul Beck and Tom Sprague, showcasing equipment from the Museum of Broadcast Technology in the booth “next door.”
